Deliver CSR tables, entry products and index-boundary tests.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for PETSc CSR SpMV: architecture,ownership and data interfaces: Dense dot 6+0−5=1 matches CSR; skipping x 1 must not renumber global columns. Label inputs, outputs, units and provenance; separate sourced architecture from synthetic observations.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Draw rowptr [0] = 0 and rowptr [1] = 2 with two nonzero entries. Compare the dense row [2, 0, −1]. Verify 1/−1, monotonic rowptr, last=nnz and valid column bounds. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。稠密內積6+0−5=1，CSR亦1；必須忽略x1但不移除其全域索引；對介面圖逐一標明輸入、輸出、單位與來源；實際架構敘述和合成量測必須分欄。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Dense dot 6+0−5=1 matches CSR; skipping x 1 must not renumber global columns. Label inputs, outputs, units and provenance; separate sourced architecture from synthetic observations.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 稠密內積6+0−5=1，CSR亦1；必須忽略x1但不移除其全域索引；對介面圖逐一標明輸入、輸出、單位與來源；實際架構敘述和合成量測必須分欄。
steps.checkEn: Dense dot 6+0−5=1 matches CSR; skipping x 1 must not renumber global columns. Label inputs, outputs, units and provenance; separate sourced architecture from synthetic observations.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: PETSc提供稀疏矩陣介面；本課用CSR紙面結構驗證索引、非零量與輸出。
knowledge.textEn: PETSc provides sparse-matrix interfaces; a CSR worksheet verifies indices, nonzeros and outputs.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 畫rowptr[0]=0、rowptr[1]=2與兩個非零；用稠密列[2,0,−1]對照；1/−1正確，rowptr單調、末值等於nnz且列索引在向量範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Draw rowptr [0] = 0 and rowptr [1] = 2 with two nonzero entries. Compare the dense row [2, 0, −1]. Verify 1/−1, monotonic rowptr, last=nnz and valid column bounds.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: CSR一列y_i=sum values[k]×x[col[k]]；rowptr界定半開區間，零可不儲存。
knowledge.textEn: CSR row y_i sums values[k] x[col[k]] over a rowptr half-open interval; zeros may be omitted.
